newsitem.title: UK: British industrial output unchanged in January.
newsitem.headline: British industrial output unchanged in January.

text.p: British industrial output was unchanged in January for a 2.4 percent year-on-year rise, official data showed on Wednesday.
Manufacturing output rose 0.3 percent for a 1.6 percent year-on-year rise. The figures were in line with analysts' expectations.
The British Treasury said the figures showed manufacturing industry continued to enjoy expansion.
Government bonds inched up after the figures which could indicate manufacturing output would slow in coming months, analysts said.
